title: Compare two activities
how: The same route or segment run twice: lined up point by point along it, to see where you gained or lost. Different courses: the totals, each kilometre, pace / heart rate / power over the run (x axis: share completed by default), and the pace uphill, on the flat and downhill.
pick_two: Pick two activities and press Compare.
pick_diff: A and B must be two different activities.
no_races: No activity is marked as a race yet (the Race button in the activity list)
no_dist: These activities have no distance data, so no splits
no_elev: No elevation data, so no gradient groups
sum.sub: B − A: a negative time or pace = B was faster (green)
splits.sub: Each kilometre's time as a pace; the last part km at its real length
ov.note: One point every 0.5% of the distance; pace averaged over 1.5% around it, standing still (slower than 60 min/km) not drawn. The x axis is the share completed, the distance or the elapsed time.
gr.sub: Every {bin} m by its gradient: uphill > {up}%, downhill < −{down}%, the rest flat (estimated thresholds)
shared.sub: Point by point shows that stretch lined up along the path
shared.name: Segment
al.sub: Both runs lined up point by point along the path: pace and heart rate at the same spot; below, B's time gap to A.
al.gap: B's time gap to A (s, positive = B behind)
aligned_none: Both ran the same route, but they can't be lined up point by point ({why}), so they're compared as different courses.
